title: EgoLink: Egocentric Language-Vision Interactive Network Knowledge Challenge Summary
abstract: arXiv:2611.21690v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The EgoLink Challenge at ACM Multimedia 2026 benchmarks egocentric multimodal intelligence linking first-person perception, social reasoning, and interactive action. Unlike benchmarks centered on visible objects and activities, EgoLink evaluates whether models can interpret emotional and social cues, resolve visually grounded references, and convert user requests into verified tool-mediated actions. Its two tracks cover social reasoning in egocentric video and interactive agents that complete service tasks through dialogue, tool use, and closed-loop execution. Together, they test whether perception, reasoning, and decision-making remain coupled under both offline question answering and state-changing interaction. We highlight a multi-stage Track 1 data pipeline for multiple-choice question (MCQ) generation, chain-of-thought generation, automatic quality grading, and video-contribution filtering. We summarize the task design, evaluation

translated_title: EgoLink：以自我为中心的语言-视觉交互网络知识挑战赛概览
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.21690v1 发布类型：cross。摘要：ACM Multimedia 2026 的 EgoLink 挑战赛对连接第一人称感知、社会推理与交互行为的多模态智能进行基准测试。与以可见物体和活动为中心的基准不同，EgoLink 评估模型能否解读情绪与社会线索、解决基于视觉的指代问题，并将用户请求转化为经过验证的、由工具中介的行动。其两条赛道分别涵盖自我中心视频中的社会推理，以及通过对话、工具使用和闭环执行来完成服务任务的交互式智能体。两者共同检验感知、推理与决策能力在离线问答和改变状态的交互中能否保持耦合。我们重点介绍了赛道 1 的多阶段数据流水线，包括多选题（MCQ）生成、思维链生成、自动质量评分以及视频贡献度过滤。我们总结了任务设计与评估（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: EgoLink 挑战赛通过自我中心视频社会推理与交互式智能体两条赛道，系统评测了第一人称视角下感知、社会推理与工具介导行动保持耦合的多模态智能。
en_tdlr: The EgoLink Challenge benchmarks egocentric multimodal intelligence through two tracks—social reasoning in egocentric video and tool-mediated interactive agents—testing whether perception, reasoning, and decision-making remain coupled under both offline QA and state-changing interaction.
